dengue virus genotype influences the ability of the mosquito vector, Ae. aegypt, to transmit dengue virus.

1) the infecting genotype determines the ability of dengue viruses to replicate in Ae. aegypt in the midguts and salivary glands, and 2) the infecting viral genotype determines the ability to transmit dengue viruses by Ae. aegypiti, with the Southeast Asian genotype being much more efficient at transmitting the viruses that can lead to severe dengue disease.
